name: Avatar of Bats
description:
• While gliding, sneaking causes you to echolocate, highlighting mobs within 40 blocks and granting night vision for 10 seconds.

  • While in light levels of 4 or less, mobs only detect you from [effect:detection][dark-gray]60-25%[/dark-gray][/effect] of their usual distance.

effects.explanation: Scales down based on light level.
